A match means only that the cited OpenBMT evidence is relevant to the behavior; status and unmet_scope preserve the difference between engine primitive, native prototype, scoped legacy workflow, and release validation.
Native Android checkout evidence is separate from legacy owner/counter engines and from documentation-only vendor claims.

OpenBMT capability metadata represents pure authorization/revocation/expiry/scope metadata and does not establish authentication, staff UI, or enforcement.
Local durable events and replay are not the owner Requests API, an external merchant API, or webhooks.

Lightning readiness assessment and funding gate are point-in-time/scoped receiver behavior; they do not guarantee routes, liquidity, uptime, full receiver readiness, backup freshness, or independent exit.
UTXO maintenance is advisory only; it does not automatically select, consolidate, sign, or broadcast coins.
Every candidate claim not directly mapped is retained as not_assessed; unmatched does not mean absent.
Positive stages were manually limited to exact narrow overlaps after claim-by-claim review; adjacent boundary evidence never upgrades an unimplemented central action.
